subject: What AI helpers will ask you to hand over
headline: Every AI company wants to run your life. What will each one ask you to hand over?

files.name: 1-can-it-do-the-job.png
files.purpose: First, can it actually do the job for you? Muse opens websites, fills in forms and books things. It'll even negotiate for you. Muse gets a nine.

files.name: 2-what-it-costs.png
files.purpose: Then price. Muse is free for most things. Gemini and Claude cost about twenty dollars a month. ChatGPT's assistant, called dots, starts at a hundred dollars a month.

files.name: 3-reach.png
files.purpose: Then reach. Meta also owns Instagram and WhatsApp, apps you already open every day. Gemini works with your Gmail. Another ten for Muse.

files.name: 4-asks-first.png
files.purpose: Do these assistants ask before they spend your money or send your emails? Claude is the most careful. Muse checks too, and gets an eight.

files.name: 5-who-can-read-it.png
files.purpose: Who can read your stuff? Muse keeps your emails and logins on Meta's servers. Meta says it can still get to your data if it needs to. Muse gets a three. Siri gets a nine.

files.name: 6-whose-side.png
files.purpose: And whose side is it on? Meta makes almost all its money from ads. Google is an ads business too. Claude and ChatGPT charge you a subscription. Muse gets another three.

files.name: 7-seen-to-picked.png
files.purpose: When an assistant shops for you, you don't see a list. You get one answer. Shops will stop paying to be seen, and start paying to be picked.

files.name: 8-the-scorecard.png
files.purpose: Add it all up, and Muse ties with Siri. Muse does the most, but Meta can see the most. Siri does the least, but keeps your stuff private.

files.name: 9-prediction.png
files.purpose: My prediction. By the end of 2027, businesses will be paying to be the one your AI assistant picks.
